title: 第28章 追兵现身，探秘星河古墓
novel_title: 欠我时间债，天道也得跪着还
content_zh:
北域雪原并非无人之地。

    这个道理，苏余在第九天凌晨被一记沉重的踏雪声惊醒时才真正明白。

    他猛地睁开眼，篝火已熄灭多时，只剩几缕青烟在黑暗中袅袅升起。

    守种兽仍然蹲在石室门口，但它的晶石眼窝已从温暖的淡金色切换成了战斗前的暗红色，青铜身躯微微前倾，四肢的关节处发出极细微的金属摩擦声——那是它在进入警戒状态时才会有的反应。

    它在警告主人：有东西来了。

    林霜也在同一瞬间醒来，手已按在剑柄上。

    两人对视一眼，不需要说话，同时起身朝地面出口无声摸去。

    这是苏余例行巡视地面的日子。

    他每隔两天会上地面一次，在避难所方圆五里内巡查一圈，顺便猎些雪原妖兽补充肉食。

    但这一次，他还没出地面就感觉到了不对——地面上的风声不对。

    不是暴风雪那种持续而均匀的呼啸，而是被什么东西从中间切断了，出现了一瞬间极其短暂的断裂。

    那是有人在雪地上高速移动时，身体撞破风幕留下的声音痕迹。

    他贴着地面出口的石壁，从积雪缝隙中往外看去。

    晨光微弱，风雪漫天。

    在避难所东北方向约三里处的一处雪谷中，一串脚印正在被风雪快速掩埋，但脚印的轮廓还依稀可辨。

    苏余悄无声息地爬出地面，匍匐在积雪中向那行脚印快速接近。

    他必须在脚印被风雪彻底掩埋之前看清它的来历。

    脚印很深，踩在积雪上留下清晰的纹路。

    那是云纹长靴的鞋印——鞋底压出的云纹图案精致而规整，这种靴子只有青云宗内门弟子才会配发。

    他用指尖在脚印边缘轻轻按压，积雪还没有完全冻结，说明脚印的主人离开不到两个时辰。

    看足印深度，对方没有负重，步幅均匀，每一步都踩得稳稳当当，是在正常行走而非逃命或追击。

    这说明对方不是偶然路过，而是在有目的地搜索什么东西。

    搜索的范围正好覆盖了这座雪谷——距离地下避难所地面出口不到三里。

    他顺着脚印无声追踪了一小段路。

    利用时之种强化后的时序感知，他将自己的心跳和呼吸频率调整到与风雪的节奏完全同步——风声起时他移动，风声落时他静止。

    这是猎人在暴风雪中追踪猎物最隐秘的手段，也是他爹教给他的最后一项狩猎技巧。

    在雪谷深处，那行脚印与另外三行脚印汇合了。

    三行脚印中有两行同样穿着云纹长靴，还有一行脚印格外沉重——每一步都在积雪上踩出深达数寸的凹坑，脚印边缘的积雪不是被踩下去的，而是被一股无形的力量直接压成了坚冰。

    那是结丹期修士特有的灵压外泄留下的痕迹。

    不是刻意释放威压，而是体内灵丹太过庞大，走路时自然溢出的灵力便足以让积雪在接触到鞋底之前先被压成冰。

    四行脚印汇合后沿着雪谷向外延伸，渐渐消失在风雪中。

    他们似乎已经搜索完毕离开了——至少暂时离开了。

    苏余回到地下避难石室时，脸色比外面的风雪还冷。
content_en:
The snowfields of the Northern Territory are not uninhabited land.

Su Yu truly understood this truth when he was awakened by a heavy sound of treading snow in the early morning of the ninth day.

He opened his eyes suddenly. The bonfire had been extinguished for a long time, and only a few wisps of smoke were left curling up in the darkness.

The Seed Guard Beast is still squatting at the door of the stone chamber, but its spar eye sockets have switched from the warm light gold to the dark red before the battle. The bronze body leans forward slightly, and the joints of its limbs make a very slight metallic friction sound - this is its reaction when it enters an alert state.

It is warning its owner: something is coming.

Lin Shuang also woke up at the same moment, with his hand on the hilt of the sword.

The two looked at each other without speaking, and stood up at the same time to silently touch towards the exit on the ground.

This is Su Yu's routine day of patrolling the ground.

He goes to the ground once every two days, patrols within a five-mile radius of the shelter, and hunts some snow monsters to supplement his food.

But this time, he felt something was wrong before he even left the ground - the sound of the wind on the ground was wrong.

It was not the continuous and even roar of a snowstorm, but something cut it off in the middle, and there was an extremely brief break.

That was the sound trace left by someone's body crashing through the wind curtain while moving at high speed on the snow.

He pressed against the stone wall of the ground exit and looked out through the gaps in the snow.

The morning light was weak and the sky was full of wind and snow.

In a snow valley about three miles northeast of the shelter, a series of footprints are being quickly buried by the wind and snow, but the outline of the footprints is still vaguely discernible.

Su Yu climbed out of the ground quietly, crawled in the snow and quickly approached the set of footprints.

He had to see where the footprints came from before they were completely buried by the wind and snow.

The footprints were deep, leaving clear lines on the snow.

Those were the prints of moiré boots - the moiré patterns pressed out of the soles were exquisite and regular. These boots were only issued to inner disciples of the Qingyun Sect.

He pressed lightly on the edge of the footprints with his fingertips. The snow was not completely frozen yet, indicating that the owner of the footprints had been gone for less than two hours.

Judging from the depth of the footprints, it can be seen that the opponent is not carrying any weight, his strides are even, and each step is firm. He is walking normally rather than escaping or pursuing.

This shows that the other party is not passing by by chance, but is searching for something purposefully.

The scope of the search happened to cover this snow valley—less than three miles from the ground exit of the underground shelter.

He followed the footprints silently for a short distance.

Using the timing perception enhanced by the Time Seed, he adjusted his heartbeat and breathing rate to be completely synchronized with the rhythm of the wind and snow - he moved when the wind blew up, and stayed still when the wind blew down.

This is the most secretive way for hunters to track prey in a snowstorm, and it is also the last hunting skill his father taught him.

Deep in the snow valley, that line of footprints merged with three other lines of footprints.

Two of the three lines of footprints were also wearing moiré boots, and one line of footprints was particularly heavy - each step made a dent several inches deep in the snow. The snow at the edge of the footprints was not stepped down, but was directly pressed into solid ice by an invisible force.

Those are the traces left by the leakage of spiritual pressure unique to monks in the pill-forming stage.

It's not that he deliberately releases the pressure, but the elixir in his body is too huge, and the spiritual power that naturally overflows when he walks is enough to crush the snow into ice before it touches the soles of his shoes.

The four lines of footprints merged and extended outward along the snow valley, gradually disappearing into the wind and snow.

They seemed to have finished their search and left—at least temporarily.

When Su Yu returned to the underground refuge stone room, his face was colder than the wind and snow outside.
